description: This file declares an API for an event producer system that broadcasts encoded events via multicast UDP sockets. It provides functions for initialization, broadcasting events encapsulated in JSON objects, and shutdown. The header is designed to be compatible with both C and potentially other languages, closely mirroring a Java event producer.

methods.name: initEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the event producer with a specific service ID used to filter events on the consumer side.

methods.name: broadcastEvent
methods.description: Sends a JSON-encoded event to multicast groups for listeners to receive.

methods.name: shutdownEventProducer
methods.description: Closes resources and sockets associated with the event producer, typically during shutdown.
